The cloud lingers in the air for the duration. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned in this way, a creature must use its action to Dodge. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds; a strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

name: Summon Fey

components.material: a gilded flower worth 300+ GP

description: You call forth a Fey spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Fey Spirit stat block (Bewitcher, Fuming, or Mirthful). When you cast the spell, choose the creature's mood: Bewitcher, Fuming, or Mirthful; this choice determines the specific features of the stat block. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count and it acts immediately after you. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.
higherLevel: Use a spell slot of 4th level or higher; the creature's statistics scale by slot level (proficiency bonus increases, hit points and attack damage scale accordingly).

name: Tiny Hut

components.material: a small crystal bead

description: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area. Nine creatures of Medium or smaller size can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if the dome's area includes a larger creature or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast the spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the space is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque from the outside, of any color you choose, but transparent from the inside.

name: Tongues

components.material: a small clay model of a ziggurat

description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt. Until the spell ends, you can make the attack again on each of your turns as an action.
higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Water Breathing

components.material: a short reed or piece of straw

description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

name: Water Walk

components.material: a piece of cork

description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface — such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava — as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures you can see within range gain this ability for the duration. If you target a creature submerged in a liquid, the spell carries the target to the surface of the liquid at a rate of 60 feet per round.

name: Wind Wall

components.material: a tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin

description: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Strength saving throw, taking 3d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall. Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward. Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and miss automatically.

name: Arcane Eye

components.material: a bit of bat fur

description: You create an Invisible, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration and sends you visual information (Darkvision 30 ft). As a Bonus Action you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction; it can pass through openings as small as 1 inch.

name: Charm Monster
description: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw (with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it). On a failure, it has the Charmed condition (Friendly to you) until the spell ends or you or your allies damage it. It knows it was charmed afterward.
higherLevel: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Legend Lore

components.material: incense worth 250+ GP, consumed, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each

description: Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to mind a brief summary of significant lore about it, as determined by the GM. The more you already know, the more precise the result. If the thing isn't actually famous, the spell fails.

name: Summon Dragon

components.material: an object with the image of a dragon, worth 500+ GP

description: You summon a Draconic Spirit that appears in an unoccupied space you can see. It is an ally, acts on your turn, and scales with the spell slot used (AC 14 + slot level, HP 50 + 10 per slot level above 5). It can make a Rend attack and a Breath Weapon. (Summon stat block is tracked manually.)
higherLevel: The spirit's AC, HP, and damage increase with the spell slot level used.
